patent_status.interpretation: VIEshunt team continues to publish academic papers only. NO patents detected as of V8 watch.

technical_changes_v7_to_v8: No new VIEshunt patents detected. Scopus paper count stable. Zone MPC paper (IEEE CDC 2025) remains the key predictive-control risk.

risk_assessment.predictive_control_frontier: VIEshunt team is heading toward predictive control (Zone MPC paper). V7 simulation showed predictive control has CEILING (does not outperform instantaneous ΔP). VIEshunt may hit the same ceiling.
risk_assessment.venous_aware_differential: VIEshunt paper does NOT use venous pressure. V8 derivative attack showed derivative has marginal value (9.9% M2 reduction vs C3, fails 15% milestone threshold).
risk_assessment.overall_risk: MODERATE — VIEshunt is an emerging competitor but has not yet filed patents. Their academic work is converging on the same frontier we explored (predictive control) and found the same ceiling. Monitor for patent filings that claim predictive or derivative control before us.

action_items: Monitor Scopus quarterly for new Flürenbrock papers
Monitor PatSnap quarterly for VIEshunt/Flürenbrock/ETH+shunt patents
If VIEshunt files a patent on venous-aware or derivative control, escalate immediately
Our L3d derivative mechanism has marginal value (V8 CEILING) — consider whether patent filing is worthwhile before VIEshunt enters the space
